description: This file defines the Amortization class within the PhpSpreadsheet library, providing functions for calculating asset depreciation and amortization schedules, specifically implementing methods like AMORDEGRC and AMORLINC with validation and date calculations.

classes.name: Amortization
classes.description: Class providing methods to calculate asset depreciation using French accounting system formulas and related calculations.

methods.name: AMORDEGRC
methods.description: Calculates the depreciation for each accounting period using the French AMORDEGRC method, considering asset cost, purchase date, first period date, salvage value, period number, rate, and basis.

methods.name: AMORLINC
methods.description: Calculates the depreciation for each period with the linear method used in French accounting, taking into account asset parameters similar to AMORDEGRC.
